title: Edit Location shows a per-day (Mon-Sun) From-To business-hours editor
refs: SV-8699 (§4.2 Working Hours - per-day From/To editor)
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Edit Location screen.
2. The 'Set business hours for this shop' toggle is ON.
custom_steps:
1. Read the per-day rows shown when business hours are ON.
2. Set a From time and a To time for one day (for example Monday).
3. Save the location settings.
custom_expected:
1. There is one row per day of the week, Monday through Sunday.
2. Each day has a From time and a To time you can set.
3. The saved shop business hours are used by the Schedule (start-time hierarchy, before/after-hours conflicts, business-hours shading).
